data.name: allocation_event_validate_insert
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER allocation_event_validate_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_allocation_events
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM party_ledger_entries s
    JOIN party_ledger_entries t ON t.id = NEW.target_entry_id
    WHERE s.id = NEW.source_entry_id
      AND s.party_account_id = NEW.party_account_id
      AND t.party_account_id = NEW.party_account_id
      AND s.amount_paise < 0
      AND t.amount_paise > 0
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'allocation source/target signs or account are invalid') END;

  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.event_type = 'allocate' AND (
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'allocate' THEN amount_paise ELSE -amount_paise END)
              FROM ledger_allocation_events WHERE source_entry_id = NEW.source_entry_id), 0) + NEW.amount_paise
      > ABS((SELECT amount_paise FROM party_ledger_entries WHERE id = NEW.source_entry_id))
    OR
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'allocate' THEN amount_paise ELSE -amount_paise END)
              FROM ledger_allocation_events WHERE target_entry_id = NEW.target_entry_id), 0) + NEW.amount_paise
      > (SELECT amount_paise FROM party_ledger_entries WHERE id = NEW.target_entry_id)
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'allocation exceeds source or target open amount') END;

  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.event_type = 'release' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM ledger_allocation_events original
    WHERE original.id = NEW.reverses_event_id
      AND original.event_type = 'allocate'
      AND original.source_entry_id = NEW.source_entry_id
      AND original.target_entry_id = NEW.target_entry_id
      AND original.party_account_id = NEW.party_account_id
      AND original.shop_id = NEW.shop_id
      AND NEW.amount_paise <= original.amount_paise - COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(amount_paise) FROM ledger_allocation_events release_event
        WHERE release_event.event_type = 'release' AND release_event.reverses_event_id = original.id
      ), 0)
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'allocation release is invalid or exceeds remaining allocation') END;
END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shops" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), "owner_name" TEXT, "phone" TEXT, "address" TEXT, "locality" TEXT, "locale_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en' CHECK (locale_code IN ('en', 'te')), "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR' CHECK (currency_code = 'INR'), "time_zone" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "parties" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(display_name)) > 0), "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "primary_phone" TEXT, "normalized_phone" TEXT, "alternate_phone" TEXT, "address" TEXT, "locality" TEXT, "notes" TEXT, "customer_credit_limit_paise" INTEGER CHECK (customer_credit_limit_paise IS NULL OR customer_credit_limit_paise >= 0), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER, UNIQUE(id, shop_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "party_accounts" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "party_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES parties(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "role" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('customer', 'supplier')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(party_id, role), UNIQUE(id, shop_id), FOREIGN KEY(party_id, shop_id)REFERENCES parties(id, shop_id)ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "financial_transactions" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "party_account_id" TEXT REFERENCES party_accounts(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "transaction_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (transaction_type IN ('opening_balance', 'customer_credit', 'customer_payment', 'customer_sales_return', 'supplier_purchase', 'supplier_payment', 'supplier_purchase_return', 'customer_refund', 'supplier_refund', 'expense', 'cash_adjustment', 'bank_adjustment', 'party_adjustment', 'transaction_reversal')), "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_paise > 0), "effective_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "business_date" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(business_date) = 10), "description" TEXT, "reference_number" TEXT, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "related_transaction_id" TEXT REFERENCES financial_transactions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "reversal_of_transaction_id" TEXT REFERENCES financial_transactions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(reversal_of_transaction_id), UNIQUE(id, shop_id), FOREIGN KEY(party_account_id, shop_id)REFERENCES party_accounts(id, shop_id)ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "party_ledger_entries" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "party_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES party_accounts(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES financial_transactions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "entry_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entry_kind IN ('opening', 'charge', 'payment', 'return', 'adjustment', 'reversal')), "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_paise <> 0), "due_at" INTEGER, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(transaction_id, party_account_id), UNIQUE(id, party_account_id), UNIQUE(id, shop_id), FOREIGN KEY(party_account_id, shop_id)REFERENCES party_accounts(id, shop_id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY(transaction_id, shop_id)REFERENCES financial_transactions(id, shop_id)ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "party_id" TEXT REFERENCES parties(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "source_ledger_entry_id" TEXT, "reminder_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reminder_type IN ('customer_due', 'supplier_due', 'backup')), "scheduled_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notification_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('scheduled', 'cancelled', 'triggered', 'share_sheet_opened')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(party_id, shop_id)REFERENCES parties(id, shop_id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY(source_ledger_entry_id, shop_id)REFERENCES party_ledger_entries(id, shop_id)ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "money_accounts" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), "account_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (account_type IN ('cash', 'bank', 'upi_settlement', 'other')), "opening_balance_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "opening_effective_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(id, shop_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_closings" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "money_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES money_accounts(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "business_date" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(business_date) = 10), "expected_cash_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "counted_cash_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (counted_cash_paise >= 0), "variance_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "denomination_counts_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT, "revision_number" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision_number > 0), "supersedes_closing_id" TEXT REFERENCES daily_closings(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(money_account_id, business_date, revision_number), FOREIGN KEY(money_account_id, shop_id)REFERENCES money_accounts(id, shop_id)ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_logs" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT, "metadata_json" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "backup_history" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "backup_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "app_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "record_counts_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "checksum_sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "destination_label" TEXT, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('created', 'verified', 'failed')), "failure_code" TEXT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX reminders_status_schedule_idx ON reminders (shop_id, status, scheduled_at)
CREATE INDEX closings_account_date_idx ON daily_closings (money_account_id, business_date, revision_number DESC)
CREATE INDEX audit_entity_created_idx ON audit_logs (entity_type, entity_id, created_at DESC)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "money_movements" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES financial_transactions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "money_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES money_accounts(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "payment_method" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (payment_method IN ('cash', 'upi', 'bank_transfer', 'cheque', 'other')), "direction" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('inflow', 'outflow')), "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_paise > 0), "reference_number" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(transaction_id, shop_id)REFERENCES financial_transactions(id, shop_id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY(money_account_id, shop_id)REFERENCES money_accounts(id, shop_id)ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_categories" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (is_default IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE CHECK (is_active IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(id, shop_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES financial_transactions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "category_id" TEXT REFERENCES expense_categories(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "category_name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "payee" TEXT, "note" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(transaction_id, shop_id)REFERENCES financial_transactions(id, shop_id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY(category_id, shop_id)REFERENCES expense_categories(id, shop_id)ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_items" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_micros" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity_micros >= 0), "unit_name" TEXT, "unit_price_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price_paise >= 0), "line_total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (line_total_paise >= 0), "line_number" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (line_number > 0), FOREIGN KEY(transaction_id, shop_id)REFERENCES financial_transactions(id, shop_id)ON DELETE RESTRICT);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shops(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES financial_transactions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size_bytes > 0), "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(transaction_id, shop_id)REFERENCES financial_transactions(id, shop_id)ON DELETE RESTRICT);
CREATE INDEX movements_account_created_idx ON money_movements (money_account_id, created_at DESC)

CREATE TRIGGER allocation_event_validate_insert BEFORE INSERT ON ledger_allocation_events BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM party_ledger_entries AS s JOIN party_ledger_entries AS t ON t.id = NEW.target_entry_id WHERE s.id = NEW.source_entry_id AND s.party_account_id = NEW.party_account_id AND t.party_account_id = NEW.party_account_id AND s.amount_paise < 0 AND t.amount_paise > 0) THEN RAISE (ABORT, 'allocation source/target signs or account are invalid') END;SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.event_type = 'allocate' AND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'allocate' THEN amount_paise ELSE -amount_paise END) FROM ledger_allocation_events WHERE source_entry_id = NEW.source_entry_id), 0) + NEW.amount_paise > ABS((SELECT amount_paise FROM party_ledger_entries WHERE id = NEW.source_entry_id)) OR COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'allocate' THEN amount_paise ELSE -amount_paise END) FROM ledger_allocation_events WHERE target_entry_id = NEW.target_entry_id), 0) + NEW.amount_paise > (SELECT amount_paise FROM party_ledger_entries WHERE id = NEW.target_entry_id))THEN RAISE (ABORT, 'allocation exceeds source or target open amount') END;SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.event_type = 'release' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ledger_allocation_events AS original WHERE original.id = NEW.reverses_event_id AND original.event_type = 'allocate' AND original.source_entry_id = NEW.source_entry_id AND original.target_entry_id = NEW.target_entry_id AND original.party_account_id = NEW.party_account_id AND original.shop_id = NEW.shop_id AND NEW.amount_paise <= original.amount_paise - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_paise) FROM ledger_allocation_events AS release_event WHERE release_event.event_type = 'release' AND release_event.reverses_event_id = original.id), 0)) THEN RAISE (ABORT, 'allocation release is invalid or exceeds remaining allocation') END;END
